records.statement: The Sponsor vote is a timestamped independent own-node observation, not the canonical ledger itself. The current page heard 34 of 35 trusted validators and reports 9 yes / 28 required; denominator and threshold can vary with validators heard. Cross-check the canonical Amendments/Majorities ledger before treating any activation state as final.

PR #8606 is blocked, open and unmerged on develop; it adds SponsorV1_1 and SponsoredAccountCreate. Two Copilot review threads remain unresolved despite author replies, and successful checks do not equal maintainer approval or Mainnet availability.

C2FO Instant Pay funded volume, invoice count, unique capital providers and settled value are not publicly disclosed; the $525B figure is historical Early Pay activity. BNY custody balances and XRP holdings are not disclosed, and no actual XRP purchases are established.

RNTB final approval does not establish that the bank has opened or taken over RLUSD issuance/reserve custody. Standard Custody & Trust Company remains the issuer in the reviewed materials, while BNY is named primary reserve custodian. Operational transfer arrangements are unknown.

The initial sponsorship snapshot referenced eight noncanonical source IDs. Exact-head validator run 41163229467 caught the missing IDs before regression tests; fail-closed gate 41163229460 passed with merging disabled. The references have been mapped to canonical source IDs already present in the archive; no new source records were fabricated. Exact-head revalidation remains pending.
